verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order: brand, then a dominant headline, then a strong CTA on the right. But the flavour pills are reordered (Cucumber Mint, Honey Rosemary, Blood Orange) and jammed together. The legal text is split into tiny, unreadable fragments either side of the pills, and the whole stack sits tight against the top and bottom edges. B is broken: the CTA sits first on the left, ahead of the message. The 'Blood Orange' pill is cut off from the other two and tucked under the button. SOLSTICE drops below the headline, and the legal fine print on the right is about as large as the headline, so it competes with it. The pills are crowded against the bottom edge.
